title: New library rules
instructions: Kütüphane müdürü yeni kuralları açıklıyor. Uzun bir metin; eski ve yeni kuralları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Good morning, everyone. From next month, there are some changes at the City Library.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: First, the opening hours. We used to close at six, but now we will be open until eight in the evening, Monday to Friday.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: On Saturdays, we will still close at four, and we will stay closed on Sundays.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Second, you can now borrow six books at a time, not four.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: You can keep them for three weeks. If you bring them back late, you will pay twenty pence a day.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Third, food is not allowed anywhere in the library, but you can drink water.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: The computer room on the first floor is free for members, but you must book a computer at the front desk.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Finally, our new children's area opens on the fifteenth. There will be a story hour every Wednesday afternoon.

questions.prompt: What time will the library close on weekdays?
questions.feedback: Önceden altıda kapanıyordu; artık hafta içi sekize kadar açık.
questions.evidence: now we will be open until eight in the evening, Monday to Friday.

questions.prompt: How many books can you borrow now?
questions.feedback: Artık dört değil, altı kitap alınabiliyor.
questions.evidence: you can now borrow six books at a time, not four.

questions.prompt: How much do you pay if you bring books back late?
questions.evidence: you will pay twenty pence a day.

questions.prompt: What is allowed in the library?

questions.feedback: Hikâye saati her çarşamba öğleden sonra. On beşi çocuk alanının açılış tarihi.
questions.evidence: There will be a story hour every Wednesday afternoon.
